PunterSheet.title: PunterSheet
PunterSheet.description: Stores a syndicate member's cross-device horse racing selections and Joker Round nominations.

punterId.description: Unique identifier for the punter profile (e.g. punter-steve-f, punter-mark-s).

ownerId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the user who saved the sheet.

selectionsMap.description: Nested map of meetingId to raceNumber to { firstPref, secondPref, thirdPref, updatedAt }.

jokerMap.description: Map of meetingId to nominated Joker Race number (or null).

/punterSheets/{sheetId}.description: Stores per-punter cross-device racing selections and Joker Round nominations.
